tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by four different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Confirmed by CNBC: Anthropic urges a court in Washington, D.C. to rehear its appeal after the Pentagon blacklisted its artificial intelligence models over safety commitments.
Reported by The Guardian: An OpenAI employee was arrested after a recording device was found in an office.
Reported by Bloomberg Law News: A judge questions whether California law covers Google's use of customer call recordings for artificial intelligence training in a privacy lawsuit.
Confirmed by Crypto Briefing: Nvidia's share of China's artificial intelligence chip market falls to 34 percent as Huawei closes in with domestic rivals.
Reported by 9to5Mac: A judge grants Apple partial expedited discovery in a trade secrets lawsuit against former employees and OpenAI.
Free every hour.
